definitions.explanation: describes a person who is focused on the external world and who gains energy from social interaction

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{外向的|がいこうてき}な{人|ひと}だ。
{外向的|がいこうてき}な{性格|せいかく}なので、{初対面|しょたいめん}でも{話|はなし}しやすい。
examples.english: Because of my extroverted personality, I find it easy to talk even with people I just met.

examples.japanese: {外向的|がいこうてき}な{人|ひと}は{人|ひと}との{交流|こうりゅう}からエネルギーを{得|え}る。
examples.english: Extroverts gain energy from interacting with others.

notes:
COMPOUND:
{外向|がいこう} (extroversion) + {的|てき} (suffix: -like, -ish)

PSYCHOLOGY:
This is a psychological term referring to how a person directs their attention and derives energy. {外向的|がいこうてき} people feel energized by social interaction and external stimulation.

CONTRAST:
{外向的|がいこうてき} (extroverted) ↔ {内向的|ないこうてき} (introverted)

NOTE:
Both {外向的|がいこうてき} and {内向的|ないこうてき} are psychological terms popularized by Carl Jung. Most people fall somewhere on a spectrum between the two.

ADVERBIAL FORM:
{外向的|がいこうてき}に - in an extroverted manner
